name: Elena Rossi
psychographics: Prioritizes family harmony and health above all else; feels guilty when she has to cook separate meals, but refuses to compromise on her daughter's coeliac safety.
current_solutions: Instagram saved posts for gluten-free bakers; weekly trip to Whole Foods for specialty flours; uses the NHS recipe database as a baseline.
frustration: At 7:30 PM on a Tuesday in March, she realized the pre-made gluten-free pizza base she bought for £8 was actually labelled 'may contain wheat' in fine print; had to throw it away and make a rushed, soggy rice-base pizza the kids refused to eat.
decision_style: Asks two friends for recommendations, checks the allergy label twice, then buys the same brand out of habit every time.
voice: Rambling and apologetic; often starts sentences with "I feel like..." or "Sorry to bother you," but gets fiercely technical when discussing ingredient lists.
